job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Design, develop, and deliver high-quality software solutions.
Write clean, maintainable code following engineering standards.
Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve development efficiency and quality.
Develop and maintain automated tests and CI/CD practices.
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical collaboration.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance.
Solve technical issues and support continuous product improvements.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and engineering best practices.



Preferred candidate profile

3+ years of software engineering experience.
Proficiency in Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, and REST APIs.
Strong understanding of SDLC, coding standards, code reviews, testing, and version control.
Experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira and Confluence.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
